fields.name: target_containers
fields.description: Ordered list of container positions [y, x], one per cube named in the goal instruction, in the order the goal names them; each entry is the position, at the last demonstration frame, of the container that ends up hiding that cube. Filled at the first decision step from the demonstration (cube positions in the early frames, container that came down on each cube at the frame containers first appear, then that container followed frame to frame through every shuffle). Never changes afterwards; copied unchanged at every later step. e.g. [[81, 90], [87, 134]]

fields.name: put_down_count
fields.description: Number of containers the robot has picked up and then put down so far in this episode. 0 at the first decision step; increases by one at the decision step whose execution steps show the fingers reopening (from about 46% back to about 100%) while over a container, i.e. the step right after a 'put down the container' subgoal finished. e.g. 1
